name: pi-goal-x
notes: v0.31.6 sync: adopted upstream's prompt-cache fix (#67/#68): context hook appends live goal state at the request tail (pi-goal-live-context) instead of prepending, compactGoalCheckpointContext rewrites every checkpoint marker in place (no mid-history deletion that shifted the cache prefix), before_agent_start no longer injects changing state into the system prompt, and cacheGoalHistory moves existing Anthropic/Bedrock cache breakpoints before the transient tail. Fork additions preserved: persisted pi-goal-context-event channel (re-sent on session_compact), pi-goal-state-event snapshots, ui_prompt_start/end Escape-to-dialog depth (reset on session_start), change-manifest baseline capture, constant tool-surface install (installGoalTools); goal-context-filter.test.ts rewritten for compactGoalCheckpointContext semantics. Missing upstream APIs re-added: shouldInjectPostCompactReminder, buildPostCompactionGoalDelta, armPostCompactReminder/isPostCompactReminderPending/clearPostCompactReminder/consumePostCompactReminder were absent in the fork's v0.31.5 sync and are now restored. Known pre-existing debt (not from this sync): tests/goal-auditor-package.test.ts D-04/D-05 fail because pi-subagents 0.15.0 injects contact_supervisor into the goal-auditor declaredBuiltin list. Known new debt (upstream-original, left unchanged per debt policy): pi-lens findings on run-gate.mjs (JSON.parse without try/catch), goal-prompt-cache.ts (no-unknown-returns), goal-prompt-cache-sdk.test.ts, and goal-prompt-cache.test.ts.
